instructions:
# NATS Consumers

JetStream consumers read messages from a stream, tracking delivery and acknowledgements per consumer.

## What this skill does

- Creates push and pull consumers
- Configures ack policies, max-deliver and backoff
- Inspects delivery stats and errors

## When to use

- Reliable event processing with redelivery
- Worker pools pulling batches of messages

## Real commands

```bash
# Pull consumer with explicit acks and redelivery
nats consumer add ORDERS NEW --pull --deliver all --ack explicit --max-deliver 5

# Push consumer to a delivery subject
nats consumer add ORDERS PUSH --push --deliver subject ords.push

# List and inspect
nats consumer ls ORDERS
nats consumer info ORDERS NEW

# Delete
nats consumer rm ORDERS NEW
```

## Ack policies

- `--ack explicit`: ack each message (default for pull)
- `--ack all`: ack all up to sequence number
- `--ack none`: fire-and-forget
- `--ack at-least-once`: auto-ack on receipt

## Best practices

- Name consumers for their workload (e.g. `email-sender`)
- Set `--max-deliver` to bound poison messages
- Monitor `num_ack_pending` and `num_redelivered` in consumer info
